note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified. Values, relevance marks and rule text are supplied by the author; the lens only shows how the supplied overlay changes when one supplied value is replaced — it never decides that a rule applies, that the cases are alike in law, or any outcome.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional loan of a ladder: the lens lifts out the return-date slot; case B's value 'No return date agreed' is replaced by 'Return date agreed', so B's print slides onto A's and the two overprint ('≠' becomes '='); the old value stays struck through in the note and a marker stays on the slot.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative in the opposite direction: a lent bicycle; the loan-length slot first coincides ('Kept for two days' in both cases), then case B's value becomes 'Kept for one month' with a different pictogram, so B's print lifts off A's and moves beside it ('=' becomes '≠'); the rule caption changes from similarity to difference, as supplied.
